note: Provenance for the generated offline data in maps/data/. Written by scripts/build-maps-data.js.

live_services.name: FOSSGIS Valhalla
live_services.used_for: driving routes that understand vehicle height, width, weight and avoid preferences
live_services.terms: Public instance run by FOSSGIS under a fair-use policy; self-host Valhalla for volume.

live_services.name: Overpass API (OpenStreetMap)
live_services.used_for: signed speed limits along a route, service areas, fixed cameras
live_services.terms: Volunteer-run mirrors; small chunked queries with backoff on failure.

live_services.name: TfL Unified API — Road Disruption
live_services.used_for: live road disruption in Greater London
live_services.terms: Works key-free at the public rate limit; higher limits need a free app_id/app_key.

live_services.name: Open-Meteo
live_services.used_for: weather at the hour you reach each sampled point along a route
live_services.terms: Free for non-commercial use, no key, attribution required.

live_services.name: National Highways DATEX II closures
live_services.used_for: England-wide road closures — deliberately NOT wired to the browser
live_services.terms: Needs a subscription key, which must never ship in a static page, and sends no CORS headers. Used only if the owner exports it to maps/data/road-alerts.json, which the page reads and labels with its date.
